mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity, checked, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, 1, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_id AS product_id, p.product_name AS product_name, p.main_image AS main_image, c.sku_id AS sku_id, s.specs AS specs, s.image AS sku_image, s.price AS price, c.quantity AS quantity, c.checked AS checked, s.stock AS stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS cart_id, c.product_id, p.product_name, p.main_image, c.sku_id, s.specs, s.price, c.quantity, s.stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.checked = 1 -- 关键：只取勾选项 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
